title: tanacetum kittaryanum
intro: Tanacetum kittaryanum, commonly known as the Kittaryan's tansy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum kittaryanum include its ability to act as a stimulant, carminative, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating digestive issues and relieving menstrual cramps. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
